# `/ai-recommendations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /ai-recommendations/v1/reasons/machine-account-discovery

`listMachineAccountDiscoveryReasonsV1` — List machine account discovery reasons — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the reasons that machine account discovery can report for a recommendation. Each reason has an ID and a readable message. Use this list to show a message for each reason in a machine account recommendation. Messages are localized. Send the `Accept-Language` header to choose a language. When the requested language is not available, messages are returned in the default language. The reasons are returned in the order defined by the catalog. When the catalog does not define an…

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage, idn:accounts:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `Accept-Language` (header) — default en — Preferred language for the reason messages.
- Returns 200: array of machineaccountdiscoveryreason
